observations: The table entity has versioned formats and relies on an anonymous *T block for geometric results.
Section 20.4.96.1 describes the legacy body through R21, while explicitly leaving the AutoCAD 2008 cell changes incomplete.
R24 uses AcDbTableContent; the specification leaves its round-trip connection to TABLECONTENT and TABLEGEOMETRY undocumented.

decision: Keep DWG TABLE output refused until an exact version profile, complete entity/block/object graph, and transaction are implemented. Do not infer R24 layout from the partial reader or generalize one codec across versions.

observations: The trace captures encoded/resolved entity type 506, class AcDbTable, for two AC1021 TABLE frames; this is empirical for this file/profile only and does not establish the AC1018 class number.

generated_ac1018_plain_text_encoder_cont.disposition: Generated encoder/parser consistency only. The direct codec stages body/handle buffers and publishes only on successful completion; a separate append control preserves seeded prefixes. Production route class-instance registration, physical AC1018 source-to-output comparison, *T compound graph, adapter transaction, independent readback, and native TABLE behavior remain unqualified. Keep dwgRW::writeTable refused.

validation_policy: Focused generated controls and existing-source use only; no new downloaded DWG/DXF fixture is to be committed.
blockers: A generated-profile direct body codec and AC1018 identity-based class-registration helper exist, but neither is integrated into the adapter and no complete compound writer exists.
No complete AC1018 source-to-writer profile is currently recorded; the two screened AC1018 sources stop at undocumented 0x40000/0x40020 cell override flags.
Observed AC1018 AcDbTable class numbers differ by source (528 and 523); determine the supported CLASS-map resolution policy and never treat either ordinal as a version constant.

The only newly captured AC1021 TABLE ordinal is 506 and the two AC1018 ordinals differ (528/523); no numeric ordinal is a cross-file mapping. Production must use CLASS identity and serialized manifest evidence.
The AC1018 unknown-override control now captures only the known prefix; the physical payload span and meaning of 0x40000/0x40020 remain unresolved and must not be skipped or emitted.
The generated AC1018 encoder control uses synthetic class number 562 solely to exercise the body codec; production class resolution and physical interoperability remain open.

The identity-based TABLE class registration helper is AC1018-only and not connected to public writeTable output. Generated CLASS metadata, committed instance accounting, actual entity-frame commit, and rollback now pass through a focused dwgRW transaction control. A true late *T graph-stage failure path is not implemented or injected yet.

The direct entity codec stages both streams and swaps them only after successful encoding, but no deterministic injected mid-emission failure exercises rollback; the production compound writer still needs graph-level staging and atomic publication.

The generated refusal matrix now covers the main excluded-field families but is not exhaustive at every guard branch; keep the direct entity encoder non-production until the remaining branches and compound transaction gates are satisfied.
The available AC1021 table source is semantically incomplete at cell CadValue type 48 and cannot validate a complete output route.
R24+ TABLECONTENT/TABLEGEOMETRY relationship is outside the available ODA v5.4.1 layout and must remain refused.
